context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 76 verified all 7 conversion optimization areas: (1) Microcopy benefit-driven CTAs - all CTAs use action-oriented language like 'Ver hotéis no centro', 'Comparar voos (melhor preço)', 'Reservar experiências (sem filas)'. (2) Visual hierarchy - Smart Map is prominent in TravelPlanner. (3) Conversion flow - clear path from PlanTrip to TravelPlanner. (4) Emotional layer - subtitles and footers with emotional hooks. (5) Affiliate optimization - TopBookingBar, StickyBar, PlanningHub, ContextualCTA components. (6) 'tu' tone consistency - all user-facing text uses 'tu' form (teu/tua, Recebe, Planeia). (7) Revenue maximization - multiple affiliate touchpoints throughout the journey. IfthenPay payment integration is MOCKED.
